text:
maria (PMM): Quick sync — we need a compact one-pager + webinar playbook + a short benchmark narrative for enterprise customers evaluating secure deployments (VPC / on-prem / Dedicated). Goal: give sales a 1-sheet + a webinar that converts high-trust inbound (security/SaaS infra buyers).

aj (Growth): Ok. Who's the primary audience? CISOs / platform leads? or also product engineering?

maria (PMM): Primary: CISOs + platform engineering leads at mid-enterprise. Secondary: solution architects and procurement. Keep messaging around SLAs, auditability, and predictable throughput/cost.

kevin (Data): I can pull 2 slide-worthy benchmarks: p95 latency differences (hosted vs dedicated), token cost delta with caching, and failover time to fallback model. Have a cleaned csv, will summarize as bullets.

liza (Creative): For the one-pager hero, recommend a tight headline: "Predictable LLM inference for regulated teams" — then 3 columns: Modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), Security controls, Business impact (latency/cost/SLA). I'll draft a visual.

sarah (SalesOps): Inbound routing rules — propose we tag demo requests by "deploy-mode" + "security-priority" and route: 
```
if lead.deploy_mode in ["VPC","OnPrem"] or lead.security_priority == "high": assign -> EnterpriseAE queue (notify slack #sales-enterprise)
else if lead.deploy_mode == "Dedicated": assign -> SolutionsAE queue
else: assign -> Growth SDRs
```
That script maps to HubSpot workflows.

aj (Growth): Webinar format idea: 30min + 15 Q&A. 3 segments: 1) Why deployment choice matters for scale/security (maria), 2) Benchmarks & cost tradeoffs (kevin), 3) Customer story + live routing demo (sales engineer). CTA: "Request an enterprise demo — priority routing".

kevin (Data): Bench bullets I plan to surface: 
- p95 generation latency: Hosted 220ms vs Dedicated 95ms (seq len 512, gpt-like open model)
- Token cost per 1M tokens: Hosted $X vs Dedicated $Y (with batching+cache ~30% lower)
- Failover time to fallback model: median 1.6s
I'll convert to 2 short lines + one small chart.

liza (Creative): Also need a 1-liner social post + 2 hero images (square + banner). Suggested post copy: "New: inference that meets enterprise SLAs — choose Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments with predictable latency and audit-ready controls. Join our webinar to see benchmarks."

maria (PMM): Nice. Let's keep the one-pager limited to a single page PDF that sales can attach to emails. Include: TL;DR, modes matrix, 3 benchmark callouts, routing note, simple pricing/commit hint, and CTA.

aj (Growth): For webinar promos: email cadence (invitation, reminder, 24h, 1h), LinkedIn events, and a gated landing page. I'll write the landing copy.

sarah (SalesOps): I'll implement the HubSpot workflow + Salesforce lead assignment. Also need the AE playbook: how to triage security questions and which infra contacts to loop in. I'll draft checklist.

maria (PMM): Deadline: one-pager draft by Tue EOD, webinar landing + promo copy by Wed midday, benchmark chart and speaker notes by Wed EOD. Can everyone hit that?

kevin (Data): Yes — will upload a mini CSV + slide-ready PNG by Wed EOD.

liza (Creative): Can do the hero + pdf layout by Tue EOD, will need any small quotes or customer logo approvals.

aj (Growth): I'll have landing copy and email cadence by Wed AM.

sarah (SalesOps): Workflow and AE playbook draft by Wed EOD.

maria (PMM): Great. One small ask — include a short "routing snippet" that sales can copy into emails: "If you need VPC or SLA details, mark your request as 'security-priority' and we'll prioritize a tailored demo."

liza (Creative): I'll propose two short variant CTAs for the one-pager to A/B test in emails.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar calendar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Add speakers to event by 2812345700.

maria (PMM): Perfect — I'll confirm speakers and send final briefing doc. Thanks team :rocket: :thumbsup:

aj (Growth): Quick note — Kevin, can you also give a 60s soundbite (one sentence) with the most compelling stat so we can use in promos?

kevin (Data): Yep — "With Dedicated capacity, median p95 latency drops by ~57% while batching and prefix cache cut per-token cost by ~30% for typical customer workloads."

maria (PMM): Love it. We'll iterate copy tomorrow. Closing thread for now — ping me if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
